name: 4-FMC
summary: A cathinone stimulant also known as flephedrone, appeared in 2008 marketed as a mephedrone replacement. Reportedly mild empathogenic effects.

uses.text: Flephedrone, also known as 4-fluoromethcathinone (4-FMC), is a stimulant drug of the cathinone chemical class that has been sold online as a designer drug starting in 2008.

pharmacology.en: Lab studies show it releases dopamine and noradrenaline, with a weaker effect on serotonin than mephedrone.
pharmacology.zh: 實驗室研究顯示，它會促進多巴胺與正腎上腺素釋放，對血清素的作用則比喵喵弱。
pharmacology.zhHans: 实验室研究显示，它会促进多巴胺与正肾上腺素释放，对血清素的作用则比喵喵弱。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include a racing heart, raised blood pressure, sweating, jaw clenching, insomnia, anxiety and a strong urge to keep redosing. Like other synthetic cathinones, it carries risks of heart problems, seizures, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 已知的反應包括心跳急促、血壓升高、出汗、咬緊牙關、失眠、焦慮，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。和其他合成卡西酮一樣，它有心臟問題、癲癇發作、精神病與成癮的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知的反应包括心跳急促、血压升高、出汗、咬紧牙关、失眠、焦虑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。和其他合成卡西酮一样，它有心脏问题、癫痫发作、精神病与成瘾的风险。

fact.en: The name flephedrone is a blend of fluoro and mephedrone. It appeared for sale online in 2008 as a replacement for mephedrone, which differs only by having a methyl group where flephedrone has fluorine.
fact.zh: Flephedrone這個名字是由「fluoro」（氟）與「mephedrone」（喵喵）組合而成。它在2008年開始於網路販售，作為喵喵的替代品；兩者唯一的差別是，喵喵在氟的位置上是甲基。
fact.zhHans: Flephedrone这个名字是由「fluoro」（氟）与「mephedrone」（喵喵）组合而成。它在2008年开始于网络贩售，作为喵喵的替代品；两者唯一的差别是，喵喵在氟的位置上是甲基。
